question_no: Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM) - Question 1
question: What is the primary objective of the Bank's Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM) policy?

options.A: To reduce the number of loan applications received
options.B: To maximise lending to high-risk industries
options.C: To ensure customers meet environmental/social obligations as loan conditions
options.D: To avoid any contact with government regulators

discussion: Selected Answer: C. The Bank shall insist on compliance with applicable National laws and regulations, the use of sound environmental, health & safety, and labour practices, as these are important factors in demonstrating effective corporate governance and ensuring commitment to loan obligations (section 11).
community_answer: C. To ensure customers meet environmental/social obligations as loan conditions

question_no: Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM) - Question 2
question: Under the ESRM policy, which type of projects will the Bank NOT provide financial services to?

options.B: Projects on the ESRM exclusion list

discussion: Selected Answer: B. The Bank shall not provide financial services to clients and projects / activities that are on the exclusion list of the Environmental and Social Risks Management (ESRM) Manual (section 11).
community_answer: B. Projects on the ESRM exclusion list

question_no: Environmental and Social Risk Management (ESRM) - Question 3
question: The Bank's ESRM policy requires that all applicable projects be reviewed and approved in line with which documents?

options.D: The Bank's CPG and ESRM Manual

discussion: Selected Answer: D. All applicable projects shall be reviewed and approved in line with credit processes as contained in the Bank’s CPG and ESRM Manual (section 11).
community_answer: D. The Bank's CPG and ESRM Manual
